explain.say: Imagine a message pops up: Schools closed forever, starting tomorrow! Would you share it? Fake news is false information made to look like real news. Look at the checklist on the board: six quick checks before you believe or share.

faq.q: Why do fake stories make us angry?
faq.a: Many fake stories are written to stir up strong feelings like anger or fear, because people share those posts quickly without checking. Noticing the feeling is your first clue to slow down.
asks: Why is fake news so shocking?

faq.q: How can I tell if a website is real?
faq.a: Check the web address carefully for odd spellings, look for an About page and named writers, and see whether well-known news groups link to it. A site full of ads and shouting headlines is a warning sign.
asks: How do I check a source?

faq.q: How do I check if a photo is real?
faq.a: Use a reverse image search in a search engine to see where the picture appeared first. If it is years old or from another country, the new story is probably false.
asks: How can I spot a fake photo?

faq.a: Fake news is false or misleading information dressed up to look like real news. Sometimes it is a mistake, and sometimes it is made on purpose to trick people or earn money from clicks.

faq.q: What should I do if I shared something false?
faq.a: Delete it, tell people it was wrong, and share the correct information if you can. Everyone gets fooled sometimes; fixing it is what matters.
asks: I shared fake news, what now?

facts: Finland teaches media literacy in schools and has often ranked first in Europe's Media Literacy Index.
Fact-checking groups such as Africa Check, Alt News in India and Chequeado in Argentina check viral claims.

quiz.say: A shocking post has no author and no date. What should you do first?
quiz.show: A shocking post has no author and no date. What should you do first?
quiz.why: Pausing and checking who made it stops you spreading something false.

wrong.0: Sharing fast is exactly how fake news spreads.
wrong.2: Commenting boosts the post so even more people see it.

quiz.say: What does a reverse image search show?
quiz.show: What does a reverse image search show?
quiz.why: It finds earlier copies of the picture, showing where and when it began.

wrong.1: Likes show popularity, not whether a picture is real.
wrong.2: Image searches have nothing to do with the weather.
